title: Advisor (II/III) (Col to 1stLt) and (CWO5 to WO) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
12.     MOS 0570, Advisor (II/III) (Col to 1stLt) and (CWO5 to WO) FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. Advisors have general knowledge acquired from formal
military learning center (FMLC) training and meet the minimum knowledge,
skills, and abilities defined in the Security Cooperation Training and
Readiness Manual. An Advisor understands advisor techniques and is capable of
developing a foreign counterpart and persuading them to achieve U.S.
government (USG), service, and partner nation security objectives. Marine
Advisors are proficient in their primary MOS or other unique skills. They can
analyze the operational environment and understand the influence of culture,
build and maintain relationships and rapport with counterparts, and
understand linkages to other Marine Corps missions (e.g., stability
operations, civil affairs, liaison, Stand in Forces, etc.) to further mission
objectives. Advisors recognize and mitigate cultural stress, develop and
implement training plans and events to build capability or capacity,
participate in security cooperation planning, are able to employ force
protection skills (as required by the combatant commander and/or chief of
mission), and understand USG and Service objectives and plans for an assigned
region or country.

    b. Prerequisites.       Security requirement:   secret level clearance
eligibility.

    c. Requirements. Complete the Marine Advisor Course (N03KYK3 or
N03KYKM) provided by the Marine Corps Security Cooperation Training
Detachment, Marine Corps Intelligence Schools. Exceptions may be granted for
equivalent service/joint/NATO/interagency advisor formalized training by the
occupational field manager, HQMC (PLU).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (ci), Security Cooperation/Language Regional Expertise and Culture
Training and Readiness (T&R) Manual.

    e.      Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
None.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   Security Cooperation Planner, 0560.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
